game.title: Hitman
game.blurb: Stealth action game from IO Interactive (RAWG also lists Square Enix and Feral Interactive), released 2016-03-11. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Simulation. Chapters follow the locations named in the Steam achievements.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The 2016 game is no longer sold on its own: the Steam store list has no "Hitman" (2016) app, only "HITMAN World of Assassination" (app 1659040), whose schema is named "HITMAN 3" and whose 83 achievements mix the 2016 locations (Paris to Hokkaido, the ICA Facility prologue) with later ones such as Dubai, Dartmoor, Berlin, Miami and Mumbai. To keep this entry to the 2016 game, the old app 236870 was used: it is not in the store list, but the Steam Web API still returns its 69-achievement schema (named "Hitman™") and global percentages. The coordinator may prefer to point players at World of Assassination instead. StrategyWiki redirects "Hitman (2016)" to "HITMAN" (completion stage 0, stub); its contents page now covers the whole trilogy, linking HITMAN 2 and HITMAN 3 locations too. Only Walkthrough, Gameplay, Freeform Training and The Final Test are written (the prologue); the location and mission pages are not, so it was not used. hitman.fandom.com redirects "Hitman (2016)" to "HITMAN (2016)", with about 186 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 19 of 69 Steam achievements are hidden. They were placed by their position in the Steam list, which runs location by location (for example ACH_18 and ACH_19 sit between the Paris achievements), so the location of each hidden one is a reasoned guess; "Shhhh" (82%) was put with the prologue. "Perfectionist" names three missions that StrategyWiki lists under two locations, so it sits in the contracts and style chapter.
